name: Infernal Pursuit rank 2 raises melee haste by 6% and shortens an incoming root by 30% (#769)
contract: Infernal Pursuit is CharacterAdvancement 6859 (Hellfire) with ranks 704992 and 707745. Rank 2 707745 reads 'Increases your melee haste by $s1% and reduces the duration of root effects against you by $s2%.' In Spell.dbc effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_HASTE (138), BasePoints 5 with DieSides 1 = 6, and effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD (232), MiscValue 7 (MECHANIC_ROOT), BasePoints -31 with DieSides 1 = -30; both target the caster. Both are native auras with no CoA handler: aura 138 divides the melee attack time by 1.06 (1 / 1.06 = 0.9434), and aura 232 is read by Unit::ModSpellDuration when a harmful spell with a root mechanic lands. Web 745 (Mechanic 7, DurationIndex 28 = 5000 ms, magic, physical school) is cast by a level 80 creature on each level 60 knight, so it cannot miss and each knight takes its first, undiminished root: the control knight keeps the full 5 sec and the knight with rank 2 gets 5000 * 0.7 = 3500 ms.
